name: Cheech & Chong - 1g Cart - Honeycrisp (H)
description:
Crisp, sweet, and orchard-fresh. The Cheech & Chong Honeycrisp cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

Honeycrisp delivers exactly what the name promises: crisp, juicy apple up front with a bright honeyed sweetness and a clean, refreshing finish. Blended with a hybrid terpene profile for a balanced, easygoing feel — light, smooth, and comfortable any time of day.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Honeycrisp flavor — crisp, juicy apple with a honeyed sweetness
Hybrid terpene blend — balanced and easygoing, great any time of day
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Crisp flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Cheech & Chong Honeycrisp is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
